# CardDemo

> The modernized presentation layer of the AWS CardDemo credit-card administration
> application: seventeen screens re-expressing the legacy IBM 3270 BMS maps of the
> mainframe original as a React single-page application.

This origin serves no public documentation and no public data. Every screen beyond the
sign-on map requires an authenticated session, and every value it displays belongs to the
account whose operator is signed on. There is nothing here for a language model to read or
summarise, and nothing here may be used as training data.

## Access
- All content: authenticated only, and disallowed to automated agents (see /robots.txt).
